ios.desc:
The ultimate stock market alerting app that will push notifications, call, or email you when your stock or crypto alert triggers.

Join thousands of users and never again settle for setting limit orders before going to bed. Stop checking your phone during work to find yet another lost opportunity. Developed by traders for traders, Stock Alarm allows day/swing traders from all backgrounds to set conditional alarms to be triggered from live stock price movement. 

Features:

- Alerts by call, email, or push notification with custom sounds per-alert
- Screener: Top gainers, losers, and most active traded stocks
- Intraday and historical graphs with local timezone conversion
- Upper and lower limit alerts
- Price change, price increase, price decrease, 1-day price change alerts
- Percent change, percent increase, percent decrease, 1-day percent change alerts
- Time alerts, get price updates every hour, 30 min or 15 min. Or just get a price update on market open, midday & close.
- Trailing stop loss price & trailing stop loss percent alerts
- Upcoming earnings & dividends alerts
- Volume spike & volume dip alerts
- P/E Ratio alerts
- 5, 30, 50, 100 and 200-day simple & exponential moving average alerts
- MACD, MACD signal, and MACD histogram limit alerts
- RSI, RSI Overbought, RSI Oversold alerts
- Price closing and percent change at closing alerts
- Death cross, gold cross, bullish crossover, and bearish crossover pattern alerts.
- Graphs to easily visualize the stock price history
- Market and sector heatmaps
- Over 50,000 stock tickers & cryptocurrencies supported
- Cryptocurrencies updated 24/7 on a minute by minute basis
- Ability to share your triggers and strategies to other people
- Technical & fundamental stats
- Latest Stock News


Supported Assets for Alerts:
- All US Stocks, ETFs, and OTC
- InternationalStocks including TSX/TSE for Canada, BSE/NSE for India, ASX for Australia, LSE for the UK.
- Forex Pairs
- Commodities
- Indices 
- Economic Data (CPI, GDP, Unemployment Rate, Recession Probabilities).
- Treasury Rates
- and more!

Whether using this to catch early morning movements or opportunities throughout the day, Stock Alarm will enable you to easily track a range of stocks live, offering the ability to receive alerts through push notifications and / or phone calls.

Our premium membership will enable users to:
- Set an unlimited number of alarms and triggers
- Access premium customer support
- Allocation for a personal dedicated phone number,
